_readme: Bottle profile: Owala FreeSip Sway, 30 oz, Vintage Surf (surf collection; retro waves, palm trees and surfboards). Same bottle as owala_freesip_sway_30oz, which fits (2026-11-06); this one adds the surf texture. All lengths in mm.

bottle._note: ESTIMATES, not measured. Owala publishes no base size; Pack Hacker lists the 30 oz Sway as 26.9 x 7 cm (10.59 x 2.77 in), taken here as the base. The body widens towards the lid. Measure with calipers before the full print.
bottle._BASE_DIAMETER: Side of the bottle just above the rounded bottom edge
bottle._UPPER_DIAMETER: Side of the bottle at UPPER_HEIGHT above the table. Same as BASE_DIAMETER for a straight bottle
bottle._UPPER_HEIGHT: Where UPPER_DIAMETER is measured, from the table. Above WALL_HEIGHT
bottle._CORNER_RADIUS: Rounded edge between the bottom and the side
